project.title: Launch of Centralised Residential Property Management Model
project.objective: Design and roll out a centralised model for managing a mixed residential portfolio to improve occupancy, compliance and tenant satisfaction.
deliverables: Centralised property management operating model and process map
Standard tenant onboarding and changeover procedure
Updated rental and contract documentation pack
Communication plan for owners and tenants
constraints: Rollout limited to existing residential properties only
Must comply with current building codes and rental regulations
No major capex; focus on process and documentation changes
Tenant disruption must be kept to a minimum during inspections
All new procedures must be usable by on-site staff with basic tools

risks.risk: Tenant resistance to new procedures and inspection schedule.
risks.mitigation: Provide clear communication, notice periods and a simple FAQ; phase changes by building.

risks.risk: Non-compliance with local housing and safety regulations.
risks.mitigation: Have legal team review all templates and procedures before rollout; schedule periodic compliance checks.

risks.risk: On-site staff overloaded by new reporting requirements.
risks.mitigation: Streamline checklists, pilot in a few buildings, gather feedback and adjust before full deployment.

risks.risk: Data on property conditions and occupancy is incomplete or inconsistent.
risks.mitigation: Run an initial portfolio inventory exercise and define minimum data fields required for each property.

risks.risk: Owners concerned about perceived loss of control under centralised model.
risks.mitigation: Share clear service levels, reporting cadence and escalation paths; offer opt-in options for some services.

themes.why_relevant: Ensures consistent onboarding, changeover and communication across all properties.
Directly impacts safety, compliance, tenant satisfaction and long-term asset value.
Rental agreements and procedures must align with housing, safety and energy regulations.
Transparent updates reduce complaints and build trust in the new management model.
Dashboards and reports help leadership track occupancy, issues and financial performance.

backlog.task: Map current property management processes and identify gaps for centralisation
definition_of_done: End-to-end process map drafted for at least three representative buildings
Key pain points and inconsistencies documented
List of processes suitable for centralisation agreed with senior management

backlog.task: Define centralised operating model and responsibilities matrix
definition_of_done: RACI matrix created for core activities (leasing, maintenance, billing, complaints)
Model reviewed with housing manager and management assistant
Leadership sign-off recorded in project notes

backlog.task: Create standard tenant onboarding and changeover checklist
definition_of_done: Checklist covers documentation, keys, meter readings and property condition photos
Reviewed by housing manager and real estate agent
Version 1 uploaded to shared repository and communicated to on-site staff

backlog.task: Develop updated rental agreement and addenda templates
definition_of_done: Draft rental agreement aligned with current regulations and company policies
Legal and compliance feedback incorporated
Templates added to contract pack and version-controlled

backlog.task: Compile full inventory and condition assessment of all residential units
definition_of_done: Each unit has a completed inspection form with condition notes and photos
Urgent maintenance issues flagged to housing manager
Inventory sheet updated with occupancy and key technical data

backlog.task: Design maintenance and inspection schedule for the portfolio
definition_of_done: Preventive maintenance tasks defined by building type and age
Inspection frequency set in line with safety and energy regulations
Schedule validated with building caretaker and facilities staff

backlog.task: Set up property performance dashboard structure
definition_of_done: Key metrics defined (occupancy, arrears, open issues, inspection status)
Dashboard template created in shared sheet
Data input responsibilities agreed with housing manager and finance

backlog.task: Prepare owner communication pack about the new management model
definition_of_done: Slide deck or brief outlining benefits, service levels and reporting cadence
FAQ section addressing common owner concerns
Communication plan with send-out dates and channels approved

backlog.task: Draft tenant-facing FAQ and notice templates for inspections and changes
definition_of_done: FAQ covers inspections, maintenance requests, rent payments and complaints
Notice templates comply with legal notice periods
Documents reviewed by housing manager and legal representative

backlog.task: Pilot the centralised model in two selected buildings
definition_of_done: Pilot buildings selected and confirmed with owners
New processes and checklists used for at least one full tenant cycle event
Feedback from tenants and staff collected and summarised

backlog.task: Define escalation and incident handling procedure for property issues
definition_of_done: Incident categories and severity levels defined
Escalation paths and response time targets documented
Procedure shared with building caretaker and housing manager

backlog.task: Document health, safety and energy efficiency compliance checklist
definition_of_done: Checklist includes fire safety, access, ventilation and energy performance items
Reviewed by housing manager for regulatory alignment
Checklist tested on at least one building and adjusted as needed

artifacts.title: Centralised Property Management Operating Model
artifacts.used_for: Describes target processes, roles and responsibilities for the new management model.

artifacts.title: Tenant Onboarding and Changeover Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Guides staff through consistent move-in and move-out procedures for all units.

artifacts.title: Standard Rental Agreement and Contract Pack
artifacts.used_for: Provides approved templates for rental contracts and mandatory addenda.

artifacts.title: Property Inventory and Condition Register
artifacts.used_for: Tracks each unit's condition, key data, occupancy and urgent maintenance needs.

artifacts.title: Maintenance and Inspection Master Schedule
artifacts.used_for: Plans preventive maintenance and inspections across the portfolio.

artifacts.title: Property Performance Dashboard Template
artifacts.used_for: Aggregates KPIs like occupancy, arrears and open issues for management review.

artifacts.title: Owner and Tenant Communication Pack
artifacts.used_for: Contains standard messages, FAQs and notice templates for stakeholders.

artifacts.title: Incident and Escalation Handling Procedure
artifacts.used_for: Defines how property incidents are logged, prioritised and escalated.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope and target operating model for centralised management.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message from chief executive officer announcing the project and asking for scope confirmation.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm which property types and buildings are included in the first rollout wave.
Approve the draft centralised operating model described in A1.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and finalise tenant lifecycle documents and checklists.
threads_plan.trigger: Management assistant shares first draft of the tenant onboarding and changeover checklist.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the final content and structure of the tenant onboarding checklist A2.
Approve the updated rental agreement templates in A3 for use in the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan maintenance, inspections and compliance activities.
threads_plan.trigger: Housing manager posts initial proposal for the maintenance and inspection schedule.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Set inspection frequency and scope for each building category in A5.
Confirm the compliance checklist items in T12 as mandatory for all buildings.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on KPIs, dashboard structure and reporting cadence.
threads_plan.trigger: Management assistant shares the first version of the property performance dashboard template.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the final set of KPIs to track in the dashboard A6.
Define how often performance reports are shared with owners and senior management.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Prepare pilot rollout, communication and incident handling approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Housing manager proposes two buildings for the pilot and shares draft communication plan.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the final pilot buildings and confirm pilot start date.
Approve the owner and tenant communication pack A7 and incident procedure A8 for the pilot.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async standup where each role posts progress, blockers and next steps.
Weekly review of property performance dashboard and key decisions in a summary message.
Pilot buildings check-in thread after each major tenant event (move-in, move-out, incident).
End-of-week risk and issues roundup with proposed mitigations and owners.
Post-pilot retrospective thread to capture lessons learned and process adjustments.
